name: SOMA Software - Aviation Management API
description:
# SOMA Software Public API

SOMA Software's comprehensive API for aviation operations management, designed to integrate seamlessly with external systems for inventory control, fleet management, maintenance tracking, and procurement logistics.

---

## Release Notes - v1.0.0

**Release Date:** December 2025

### Highlights

| Category | Endpoints | Features |
|----------|-----------|----------|
| Authentication | 1 | JWT token-based access |
| Reference Lists | 17 | Geographic, component, aircraft, personnel data |
| Personnel | 2 | Query and create personnel |
| Catalog | 6 | Component management (10 types supported) |
| Inventory | 6 | Warehouse, aircraft, workshop, dispatch tracking |
| Fleet | 2 | Aircraft registration and queries |
| Warehouses | 2 | Storage location management |
| Suppliers | 2 | Vendor management |
| Requisitions | 2 | Multi-item requisition support |
| Procurement | 4 | Purchase orders, currencies, terms |
| Maintenance | 2 | Discrepancies and work orders |

**Total: 48 endpoints**

---
### API Credentials

API credentials are issued exclusively by SOMA Software Technical Support. Contact [https://www.somasoftware.com/support](https://www.somasoftware.com/support) to request access.

---

## Overview

This API enables aviation operators, MROs (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul organizations), and enterprise systems to:

- **Catalog Management**: Create, query, and manage aeronautical components with full traceability
- **Inventory Control**: Track components across warehouses, workshops, and installed on aircraft
- **Fleet Management**: Aircraft registration, configuration, and technical data management
- **Personnel Management**: Register and manage organizational personnel
- **Procurement & Logistics**: Requisitions, purchase orders, and supplier management

---

## Authentication

The API uses a **two-layer authentication system**:

### Step 1: Basic Authentication (API Access)

The login endpoint requires **HTTP Basic Authentication** with the following public API credentials:

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| **Username** | `public_soma_api` |
| **Password** | `hidden` |

For security purposes, the public API key is not published in this documentation. To obtain your API credentials, please submit a request to SOMA Software Technical Support at [https://www.somasoftware.com/support](https://www.somasoftware.com/support)

### Step 2: JWT Bearer Token (Request Authorization)

After successful login, use the returned JWT token for all subsequent requests:

```http
Authorization: Bearer <your_jwt_token>
```

### Token Lifecycle

- Tokens have a limited validity period
- Implement automatic token refresh in your integration
- Store tokens securely and never expose them in client-side code

---

## Quick Start

### 1. Authenticate
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.somasoftware.com/soma-api-public/api/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Basic cHVibGljX3NvbWFfYXBpOlh5NyRQcTkhTG0yQFJ0NSNaazheVnczJk5oNipKZDE=" \
  -d '{"username": "YOUR_ACCOUNT@YOUR_COMPANY.com", "password": "YOUR_PASSWORD"}'
```

### 2. Use the Token
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.somasoftware.com/soma-api-public/api/airship" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token_from_step_1>"
```

---

## HTTP Status Codes

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `200` | Successful operation |
| `400` | Bad request - Invalid or incomplete data |
| `401` | Unauthorized - Invalid or expired token |
| `404` | Resource not found |
| `409` | Conflict - Resource already exists |
| `500` | Internal server error |

---

## Rate Limiting

Standard rate limits apply to all endpoints. Contact SOMA Software Support for enterprise rate limit increases.

---

## Support & Resources

- **Technical Support**: [https://www.somasoftware.com/support](https://www.somasoftware.com/support)
- **Email**: technicalsupport@somasoftware.com
